name: Dress Designer
desc:
👗 DESIGN YOUR OWN DRESSES!
DO NOT PLAY FASHION DESIGNER - THEY ARE A STOLEN GAME!! If you played it, you will lose progress associated with it. I apologize. 

📏Measure, ✏️Sketch, ✂️Cut and 🧵Sew beautiful dresses for your clients as the greatest seamstress in Willowby!

Build your own boutique, discover stunning fabrics, and create unique designs for every occasion, from garden parties to grand weddings.

Become Willowby's greatest Dress designer!
